params.name: PLAYBACK_ID
params.description: The asset or live stream's playback ID.

params.name: EXTENSION
params.description: The image file extension, either 'jpg', 'png', or 'webp'.

params.name: time
params.description: The time (in seconds) of the video timeline where the image should be pulled. Defaults to the middle of the original video.

params.name: width
params.description: The width of the thumbnail (in pixels). Defaults to the width of the original video.

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the thumbnail (in pixels). Defaults to the height of the original video.

params.name: rotate
params.description: Rotate the image clockwise by the given number of degrees.

params.name: fit_mode
params.description: How to fit a thumbnail within the specified width + height.

params.name: flip_v
params.description: Flip the image top-bottom after performing all other transformations.

params.name: flip_h
params.description: Flip the image left-right after performing all other transformations.

params.name: program_time
params.description: Set the time of the thumbnail for an asset created from a live stream when using the [instant clipping feature](https://docs.mux.com/guides/create-instant-clips). The timestamp should be provided as an epoch integer, and is compared to the program date time (PDT) generated by a live stream.

params.name: latest
params.description: When set to `true`, pulls the latest thumbnail from the playback ID of an ongoing live stream. Can only be used with live streams. Can be used to build moderation and classification workflows, [see documentation for more details](https://mux.com/docs/guides/get-images-from-a-video#getting-the-latest-thumbnail-from-a-live-stream).

items.docs: [Fetch a thumbnail image from a video](https://docs.mux.com/guides/get-images-from-a-video) at a specified time with optional transformations.
